problem.matrix: two seeded permutations of 1300000 columns assigned to 325000 rows

formulation: sepA: residual r = D w - x materialized as its own step, gradient applied as D^T r; D^T D never formed
equivalence_check: sepa_check.txt: identical step size; FOMTools reference iterates agree to 9.770e-14 (ISTA) and 3.511e-07 (FISTA) after 200 iterations

baselines.scipy: hand-written ISTA/FISTA with D and D^T (CSR), one CPU core, 1 warm-up + 3 solves, median
baselines.cupy: hand-written ISTA/FISTA with D and D^T on the GPU (cuSPARSE), 8 warm-ups + 10 solves, mean, includes solution download

compared_solvers.sepa: generated here (FOMTools built-in instructions and default driver)
compared_solvers.original_form: OpenMP and FISTA CUDA: verified solvers of rect325k1p3m_tol1e-5; ISTA CUDA: generated for this comparison with the same pipeline from the original-form scaffold; all timed in the same rounds

measurement.round_isolation: all seven rounds in one job holding the whole node (Slurm --exclusive); rounds_audit.txt

agent: Claude Code CLI 2.1.287 (headless), FOMTools default agent driver with built-in phase_a_instructions / phase_b_instructions
